keyCharacteristics: Near-black violet ground, tonal surfaces stepped in three levels, hairline borders instead of shadows on content.
One accent per screen, re-tinted by mode; never two accents competing.
Unbounded for the display voice, Onest for everything people read or tap.
Real place photography, credited on the image itself, no faces.
Line icons in one stroke weight; emoji are not interface icons.

rules.name: The One Lit Sign Rule
rules.body: A screen has one accent colour, the current mode's. Status, decoration and emphasis never introduce a second hue.

rules.name: The Mode Recolours Everything Rule
rules.body: Components read the accent from --accent / --on-accent / --glow; nothing hard-codes pink, so switching mode recolours the page at once.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: Under a name there is at most one line of facts (type · metro · price, or day · time · venue). A second explanatory caption is a defect.

rules.name: The No Neon Halo Rule
rules.body: Shadows are neutral black with offset and blur. A coloured, zero-offset glow around buttons or cards is not part of this world; the accent's soft radial glow lives only behind the hero panel, never around controls.
